description: This file defines an enum representing JSON input parameter keys used for creating or updating financial activity accounts in the Fineract project. It encapsulates parameters like financial activity ID and GL account ID, providing methods to retrieve all parameter values and converting enum names to a user-friendly string.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountsJsonInputParams
classes.description: An enumeration of JSON input parameter keys for financial activity account operations, including methods to access parameter values and display names.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Returns a set containing all JSON parameter values defined in the enum.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the enum constant, replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value associated with the enum constant.
